name: Advance notification for WooCommerce
author: PI Web Solution

sections.description:
Advance notification for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin designed to enhance your order management process by providing timely notifications based on specific order conditions.

WooCommerce email notifications: You can receive email notifications for new order based on various conditions such as:
– Order status
– Order total
– Product categories
– Product present in the order

Woocommerce send email after order: The plugin allows you to set up custom email notifications conditions for new orders, This email are send only when the order meets the specified conditions.

Stock alert woocommerce: Get alert when stock of specif product or product of specific category go on low stock status. You can configure different alert to be send to different product manager for different product.

WooCommerce Out of Stock Email Notification: The plugin enables you to set up automated email notifications for out of stock products in WooCommerce, ensuring you’re promptly informed and never miss a restocking opportunity.

WooCommerce Backorder notification: The plugin allows you to set up custom email notifications for backordered products, ensuring you’re promptly informed about the status of your backorders.

WooCommerce Day Condition: The plugin includes a day condition feature, allowing you to set up notifications based on specific days of the week. So you can receive notifications only on certain days, such as weekends or weekdays.

Date Condition: The plugin allows you to set up notifications based on specific dates. This ensur you receive notifications only on certain dates, such as holidays or special events.

1.0.2

  • Advance notification for WooCommerce plugin is now compatible with WooCommerce 9.9.5.
